candidate: Fixed host service-contract selection ported onto current Linux upstream

sourceManifest.scope: Exact committed source blobs; this receipt and manifest are subsequent metadata-only additions.

ancestry: Target baseline is an ancestor; original pre-port branch history was not rewritten or overlaid onto upstream.

implementation.selection: One fixed capability_id/interface_version per installed source-policy binding; explicit activate_selected permission and field must appear together.
implementation.admission: Existing authenticated UDS, source token, real peer identity, package/installation scope, current catalog/gate generation and Broker v1 activate reservation remain mandatory.
implementation.authorityRecheck: Reload and reauthenticate source policy and validate durable pin after binding serialization, before broker I/O.
implementation.revocation: Explicit selection persists requires_selected_policy; legacy Activate cannot bypass a selected binding, and recovery cannot bypass revoked or changed fixed policy.
implementation.legacyVersions: Directly reuse cy_manifest::CapabilityInterfaceVersion constructor: trim-nonempty only, retain the supplied string; no new charset or length limit. Existing repository-manifest normalization remains unchanged.
implementation.brokerWire: Unchanged four-field binding/package/installation/operation scope; no selection field added to Broker v1.
implementation.installationSwitches: UDS upgrade/rollback use exact installation activation through the existing activate reservation; standalone UDS upgrade/rollback permissions are not widened.
implementation.preserved: All upstream process locks, private Plugin data, root-only bootstrap/uninstall, recovery protections, no-replay receipts, restoration behavior and logging.
implementation.excluded: Native Windows persistence changes and pre-port proof are separate work; no portable durability or Windows transport redesign in this target.

toolchain.isolation: Task-owned Cargo home, target, source snapshot and short TMPDIR; existing pinned compiler reused read-only.

validation.note: Four child --exact helper invocations account for the log-only 330 filtered count; no top-level suite was filtered.

coverage: Real separate-process trusted Rust installation of two multi-service packages and six legacy singleton packages; no unadmitted administrative transport.
Real production UDS daemon and distinct source/daemon UIDs; the source cannot read private daemon state.
Independent fixed Graph v1/v2 workers with reachable sockets, exact-installation upgrade and rollback, owner process-group termination and admitted recovery preserving pin and rollback target.

Same request ID with another pair, old-source missing permission, unknown nested field, wrong peer/root bypass, stale generation, revoked policy, changed fixed pair and legacy Activate bypass reject before any broker I/O.
Gate denial and in-flight/completed admissions preserve the current worker and do not replay work.

Legacy slash, URN, Unicode, whitespace, 256-character and non-White-Space C0 versions pass real activation, record/serde roundtrip, owner restart and authenticated legacy-source UDS recovery. Selection/policy preserve raw strings; installed pins follow the unchanged repository normalizer.
Empty/Unicode-whitespace-only versions, wrong pairs, corruption/traversal/symlink payloads, readiness mismatch and legacy ambiguous records remain rejected.

negativeEvidence.name: legacy-version-compat-red.log
negativeEvidence.finding: The committed pre-fix narrow constructor with the new real singleton regression fails with PLUGIN_SERVICE_SELECTION_INVALID; the fix reuses the existing public manifest type.

negativeEvidence.name: pre-legacy-workspace-tests-long-tmp-red.log
negativeEvidence.finding: Six existing sandbox-client tests exceeded Linux SUN_LEN with the long task TMPDIR; final validation uses a shorter task-owned TMPDIR, with production code and original assertions unchanged.

An intermediate new parallel owner-reopen fixture observed PACKAGE_RUNTIME_ALREADY_RUNNING; the error log is retained privately. No production lock change, global serialization, ignored error or retry was introduced; subsequent default-parallel package and complete workspace runs passed.

Archive extraction preserves source mtimes, so switching red/green snapshot directories with one target cache initially reused a stale test artifact. Final scripts refresh only snapshot Rust source mtimes (bytes unchanged), compile the corrected crate, and associate actual daemon binary hashes with acceptance.

artifacts.location: Retained task-local validation-platform evidence directory; private workstation paths are not published.

limitations: Exact Broker v1 admission service and Graph business payloads are synthetic fixtures; broker owner integration, business RPC and external model/platform accounts are NOT_RUN.
Real uv venv creation is tested without installing dependency packages; official bootstrap/deployment and package/toolchain release installation are not claimed.
Twelve pre-existing workspace tests remain ignored for explicit Docker/PostgreSQL/provisioned-account/generated-bundle or internal-helper conditions; they are not silently counted as passed.
Native Windows is UNSUPPORTED / NOT_RUN for this Unix-only upstream daemon. Earlier native Windows proof is pre-port evidence only.

Formal protocol schemas, published SDK/provider pins and consumer execution are unchanged/unpublished; Selected remains gated as NOT_PUBLISHED in consumers until normal provider publication and dependency approval.
All checks are local. No remote fetch/push, CI success, PR merge, deployment, account/message action or publication is claimed.
